t: Sail the ship into the hangar, get the supplies from the Baccy Family and deliver them to the remote outpost.

Greetings!
You're not afraid of pirates, are you? We have an errand just for you: a batch of supplies to be delivered to a remote settlement.
If you want to aid our workers and earn a pretty penny, simply sail the ship into the hangar and talk to us. We'll order the workers to load the supplies into the hold.
When you reach the outpost, report your arrival to Tverdoslav Meshkov, our supplier. He'll accept the cargo and pay for the delivery. While in his office, you can also have some crates of meteorite iron loaded on your ship. Deliver them here, and we'll pay you handsomely for every crate!
Will you take up the delivery job? Simply summon the ship to the hangar and have us load the supplies!

We're glad you're willing to help us! Everyone who was on your ship's crew at the time of loading will be rewarded for delivering the cargo. When you get to the outpost, unload the cargo from the hold and see the supplier for your reward. And remember, even if we don't prepare a caravan, you can buy supplies from us, deliver them to the outposts and sell them for profit.
Capture any of the trading allods, where necessary depriving the Empire of its protectorate over it, and inform the Glowy Family of your victory.

Greetings!
You have probably already heard that we are expanding construction of astral ships, and the Free Traders are offering us the possibility of using their trade allods to produce ethereal thread needed for astral sails.
Unfortunately, the Empire also knows this and they are already planning to rob us of the opportunity to trade with these allods. Therefore, we should strike first and establish control over trade with these factories... better us than the Empire, right?
The plan is simple: on the map of astral sectors you can find the target - any neutral allod of the Free Traders, or one under the protectorate of the Empire. Jump to it and, if the Empire has already established control there, destroy their astral turret... it is not too dangerous. Then you need to go to the center of the allod and raise the League banner there... and that's it! And you don't have to do it all on your own - the main thing is to participate in the capture.
I hope that the Empire's fleet did not put up any serious resistance?

A wonderful result! Imperial ambitions have again been curtailed, and we can produce more ethereal thread as a result... The more astral sails we can make, the more ships we will have, and the better we will be able to strike against the Empire.
As a reward, take this payment and a Particle of Anomalous Matter, found by our research ships in a distant astral anomaly - it will definitely come in useful!
And remember, the trade war never stops, not even for a day!
Welcome to the Astral hangar! What can we help you with?
Buy the raw etherium from the Baccy Family, deliver it to the trading post and sell it to the Free Traders.

Greetings!
A large-scale shipbuilding program has been started for our brave astral fleet. And the sail production capacity is no longer sufficient!
The Free Traders, as always, have decided to make money on this by developing new technology for producing the necessary ethereal thread. The first stage of production is to process the etherium.
You can acquire raw etherium from me, and sell it at any trading post of the Free Traders that support us. For the first cargo of the day you will receive an additional payment.
Remember three things: first of all, you can only trade with the posts that support us, don't expect a warm welcome from the League posts. Second, the prices vary at trading allods, so if you are an experienced trader, look for ones where demand for your commodity is higher. And third, etherium may be also looted from the astral demons.
How is the etherium transportation progressing?

Excellent! We will start processing it immediately.
You can acquire the resulting ethereal solution from us and supply it to the manufactory.
Capture and stabilize the Anomalous Matter in the in the anomalous sector, then return the matter to Nastassja Ushkuynikova.

A new sector has been recently found in the Mysterious Astral, where an anomalous matter that can be used as a power source is generating spontaneously! We are extremely interested in obtaining some samples of this matter.

The wormhole leading to the Anomalous Sector opens only once a day just near the home sector. We are particularly interested in that sector and the anomalous matter, so it is your chance to improve your reputation with the Demon Hunters!

When you get there, use the scanner to find the anomalous matter. You'll recognize it at once, it looks... weird. Capture the matter and hold it on for some time until it stabilizes.

Looks like a piece of cake? Well, the problem is you're not the only soldier of fortune trying to get a reward. Other adventurers from all over the Sarnaut may try to attack you... or take away your anomalous matter. So, be on the alert!
Did you get the Anomalous Matter?

Excellent! Let's proceed to tests!
You can come back tomorrow, if you have liked working with us!
Talk to the Glowy Family in the hangar.

How did you like the Astral? Oh, that was just a start! Distant sectors are inhabited by monsters so scary your knees will tremble! But don't go away with the idea that our captain will give you rides forever. No one is going to take you there, steer yourself! We will give you a ship if you don't have any. Can you navigate at all? No? Talk to the Glowy Family, they'll give you a couple of lessons.

We remember the time when you could rather see a snowman in Novograd than an Astral ship! People used to respect captains as if they were military generals! It isn't like that anymore. Today even cats know how to navigate ships! Do you want me to teach you?

Hey there! You are good at fighting, as long as I recall, want to join us for a dangerous, but profitable business? We’re going to a haunted allod to search for treasure and fight the ghosts. And you have a chance to see the Astral with your eyes!

You’re in? Great. Go straight to the Astral Hangar to Glowy Family. They’ll take care of you.
A little more bite and a little less bark!
Get to the allod on Mercenaries' ship.

Hey there! You are good at fighting, as long as I recall, want to join us for a dangerous, but profitable business? We’re going to a haunted allod to search for treasure and fight the ghosts. And you have a chance to see the Astral with your eyes!

You’re in? Great. Go straight to the Astral Hangar, you’ll be taken care of.
Here we are. See, the Astral knowledge is not that hard to grasp.
Visit any allod in the Mysterious Astral.

Congrats, cap! Can't wait to go out to the Astral? Here's my advice for you then.

If you know for sure which sector exactly you want to go to, you don't have to travel all across the Astral. You may simply use an Astrolabe to jump directly there. Gather your friends on board, open your Astral map, switch on the Astrolabe and select a sector. Voila, you're there in one easy hop!

Next, go to the stern to the scanner - it's going to be your most often used device. You'll take your chance to learn all about its functions later. For now, you only need two of them. Oh, and bear in mind that using the scanner takes Astral emanations! If you run out of them, kill two or three demons.

So, you're at the scanner. Press "Scan for Small Allods", and you the allod, if it is in the given sector. Press "Route Tracing" to find a route to the allod, and you'll see a chain of regions, connected with lines of colors. Make sure to remember well the consequence of colors! Now you may return to the steering wheel.

Vortex connect regions. They are marked with one of the three colors: red, blue or green. The link shown on the scanner has the same color as the corresponding vortex. The route is usually put down like "blue-red-green-blue". Make your way from one vortex to another, until you see the allod that you need. Basically, that's all. Fly safely!
You better watch out when you're out there, in the Astral! It has no pity for the weak!
How was your flight? Did you have good loot? We must have a party now!
Buy ethereal thread and bring it to Michael Kazakin in the home allod.

Greetings! Here, in the factory, work is winding up - ethereal thread is being made from ethereal crystals.
This can then be used to make sails for astral ships at the wharves of large allods. If you want to earn some money, you can by the thread from me and deliver it to Michael Kazakin.
How is the ethereal thread transportation progressing?

Wonderful, now we can reach our astral sail production targets, and consequently - out shipbuilding targets too!
Remember, you can transport as much freight as you wish - we have a lot of work ahead of us.

We apologize for any inconvenience, but our trading allod is currently under the protection of a state that is hostile to you, and we have been forbidden to trade with you. If you refuse to accept this, you may try to destroy the turret located nearby.

Welcome to the Factory Allod of the Free Traders! Here we produce durable Ethereal Threat from Ethereal Crystals

We have hit production level {level}.

The Ethereal Crystal warehouse is {raw} full, the Ethereal Thread warehouse is {prod} full, total storage capacity is {capacity}.

We buy Ethereal Crystals at a price of {buyPrice} and sell thread at a price of {sellPrice}.
Buy ethereal thread and bring it to the Baccy Family in the home allod.

Greetings! Here, in the factory, work is winding up - ethereal thread is being made from ethereal crystals.
This can then be used to make sails for astral ships at the wharves of large allods. If you want to earn some money, you can by the thread from me and deliver it to the Baccy Family.
How is the ethereal thread transportation progressing?

Wonderful, now we can reach our astral sail production targets, and consequently - out shipbuilding targets too!
Remember, you can transport as much freight as you wish - we have a lot of work ahead of us.
Buy the ethereal solution and bring it to the Free Traders' manufactory.

Greetings! At our trading post we produce ethereal solution from all its primary forms, from pure etherium received from astral demons, to raw etherium collected from the astral traps in the home allod.
We produce and store the ethereal solution, which will have to be transported to the factory to be processed further.
Will you do it? For the first consignment there will be an additional payment! And, of course, try to bring the cargo to wherever the demand is greatest... and where you will not encounter enemies.
How is the ethereal solution transportation progressing?

Excellent! We will start to make ethereal crystals immediately.
These can be delivered and sold to the factory.
Buy the ethereal crystals and bring them to the Free Traders' factory.

Captain! Welcome to the factory! Here we grow ethereal crystals out of etherium solution. That’s a big seller! I am looking for a reliable captain who could take these crystals and deliver them to a crystal thread factory.
Will you do this? I will pay some extra for the first delivery! Choose those factories where they won’t fire at you - the League and the Empire keep fighting over them, and sometimes you can see blue flags waving over factories in the morning, and red ones in the evening... But as long as we get paid, I don’t care who we work for!
How is the ethereal crystal transportation progressing?

Excellent! We will immediately start to produce ethereal thread.
They are happy to buy it in the home allod - they use it to make sails for astral ships!
Steal 10 bananas from Aviaks in Windcatcher and return to Eadweard Goodwin.

Hello! Do you want to earn some money? I’ve got a contract.

Bananas are a rare fruit here, and local researchers simply love them! Local aviaks love bananas even more, and will never give them away freely. So, all you need to do is steal some from the aviaks and sell them here. Are you with me?

I’m way too old to escape from a bunch of angry aviaks, but I gather it’s not the first time you’d do it. Bring me a few bananas, and I’ll sell them at bargain prices.
Have you got the bananas? No, I don’t like them much, but the gibberlings and elves will sell their heads for them!
Aw, the bananas! So fresh, so smelly, so yellow! They will simply fly off! Here’s your reward, come again.
Kill 12 Blizzards and capture their essences into the Windcatcher’s bag, then report to Eadweard Goodwin.

Looking for work? I’ve got quite a task for you!

Aviaks believe that the wind has a living soul, this is why they call this place Windcatcher. Of course, we know that these are not souls at all, but merely air elementals, made of purest mountain air. I’ve found just a way to earn money on them!

Kill one and release the air, then collect it into this enchanted purse. Elves will thank you lots for this crystal clear air, not polluted with the city’s odors. A nice way to make money out of nothing, right?
Don’t open it, or the wind will escape!
Oh, I can hear the wind blowing in the bag! We’re going to make good money!
Steal 10 bananas from Aviaks in Windcatcher and return to Eadweard Goodwin.

Have you heard about the latest trend in fashion? It's aviak feathers! Everybody wears them on hats and accessories, it is genuine haute couture! It must have started with the Priden ladies.

We cannot afford taking no notice of it, can we? All you need to do is pluck feathers of ten aviaks and deliver them to me. The market is ready, and so are our pockets!
Beaks, claws, feathers... I never understood the modern fashion.

Sometimes I wonder what it is about these feathers. They’re not gold or diamonds, after all. Anyhow, while there is demand, there is offer, right?

Come back any time. Business is always business.
Kill Blizzie in Windcatcher and return to Eadweard Goodwin.

This task is dangerous and non-profitable, but we need to do it.

I hear them say Aviaks on Windcatcher have tamed an elemental called Blizzie. There’s no prize for guessing that they intend to let it loose on our camp! This will bring us into such big loss!

We need to destroy Blizzie. I have no idea how you are going to do it, with all the guards around, but if you manage, believe me, you will be generously rewarded.
Kill Blizzie before she turns the place upside down!
Blizzie has been destroyed? This is wonderful. Now we can safely trade!
Set 12 Rotten Treants on fire, destroy them and return to Laureen de Blizare.

Treants at the Medial Plateau are a real threat. They’re uncivilized, aggressive and very, very tough. No axe can cut through their bark.
What’s more, they’re dumb as a doorknob. You can fix up things with a common treant, but there’s no use trying to talk to these, no way! The last time I tried talking sense into them, I nearly got smashed!
As long as our reasoning won’t work, we have to teach them by methods of force. Take sizzling ambers, burn their dumb skin! The woods without them will be a way better!
I ran so fast, my feet hurt!
Nice fire! I hope it’ll prevent the treants from breaking in again.
Collect 10 Mangos at the Medial plateau and return to Laureen de Blizare.

I want a party! Life cannot be just work, work, work all day long. It’s time we have fun!
My friends and I prepared a small show. Nothing much, just dancing, fireworks, music. I wish we had decent drinks to come with this. All we got is a bottle of Orkish hooch, but I’m afraid it’ll knock out the whole expedition for the next week. I think I can brew a light cocktail from mango fruit. Please, bring me fifteen mangos, I will thank you lots.
I’m waiting for the holiday so much! I’m exhaused by dull monotonous work in this boring expedition.
The cocktail turned out great - light and tasty, and of good color. Thank you from all my colleagues!
Collect Fire Essence from Fire Elementals and return to Laureen de Blizare.

The next step of my research of fire elementals involves studying the extremely flammable substance that starts burning upon an elemental's death. The tricky thing is to extract the substance before it ignites.
I developed a procedure. Here's an enchanted vial that contains a few tons of overcooled water from the top of a glacier. Use the fire elementals' natural curiosity to lure them into water. It will make them cool down, and as they do, their inner substance will heat them again, do you dig it? Once cooled and heated, they will evaporate, leaving the naked and thickened substance for you to collect. Here's the container. Good luck.
I wonder what’s the source of his material form, provided that he’s constantly burning...
Just what I was asking for! I will start the research immediately. I am positively sure that the flammable substance may be used for heating purposes. We shall probably need more elementals...
Collect 12 Fire Essences from Fire Elementals and return to Laureen de Blizare.

I’m currently researching fire elementals, and I am one step away from a tremendous scientific discovery! Unfortunately, I’m running out of test samples, so my great discovery is postponed for an indefinite time.
I’m a scientist, not a fighter, so I cannot enter the Fiery cave and cut flaming hearts out of fire elementals myself. I will be much obliged if you bring me more of those.
Have you brought the samples yet? Hurry, I can’t wait to go on with the research.
That’s what I call burning hot! I’m sure these will be enough to complete my studies. Or not... Just in case, can I count upon your further support? Oh, thank you!
Bring 10 Cozy Panther Furs from panthers at the Northern Horn to Roughice family.

Skins! We love skins! And we love furs! They’re soft, and warm, and fluffy, just like us! Everybody likes us, it means, everybody likes furs!
You know what? We’ve got a business proposal for you! You go to the Northern Horn, kill snow leopards and bring furs!
What? Us? No, we can’t fight with them ourselves, they’re a way too scary! So, we sell the furs you bring, and share the profit! Deal?
Great! Warm cozy mittens, hats, scarves and all that will fly! I’ll be rich! Fur rich!
Obtain the Ice Shard by killing the Icy Elemental and use it to freeze 10 Mountainfolks at the Northern Horn, then return to Roughice family.

Have you heard about our favorite game, "Frost your nose"? No? It's simple. You have to find an Icy elemental here, at the Northern Horn, and have it catch your eye. It makes you freeze to the bone and turn you into one nice icy sculpture. Our little one played the game, and it took us three hours to melt him at the fire!
Now we want to play with the mountainfolks, for they threatened to shave us bold and put us to freeze.
Obtain the Ice Shard from the Icy Elemental and turn ten Mountainfolks into icy statues! That's going to teach them!
A shaved gibberling looks so pathetic. I bet they wouldn't have dared to shave a Priden!
Gear game, right? That’ll teach them!
Use the Heater to warm up 20 frozen trees and bushes on the Northern Horn and return to Roughice Family.

This never ending frost is making us sick. Everything is deeply frozen, all snow and ice, it’s no good at all. We’re so tired of it.
We’ve got a curious device from Coba Plateau. We call it "Heater". It can heat anything you like, you can even heat a whole lake, and swim in it like in a swimming pool! But no, we’re not going to waste it on heating lakes. Better make the trees warm, they’re alive, after all.
So how’s our heater working? Ah-ha!
See, we’re not rough and not icy! Now the trees won’t die of frost, and the summer will be all beautiful and green!
Use the Heater to blow up 20 mountainfolks on the Northern Horn and return to the Roughice Family.

Look what I’ve got! It’s a fire cocktail. Don’t drink it! Set it on fire, and check out its kaboom!
Mountainfolks that inhabit the Northern Horn, often gather around a fire. Drop a bottle to their campfire, let’s see how they’ll like it! Why, this would be a fair revenge, right?
That was a loud boom, even we could hear it! Come back, we’ll have fun again some day!
Take part in murdering Zirkon Kostrov and report to Leo Ordin.

I have a mission for the loyal citizens of the Empire! Together we - Orcs, Xadaganians, Arisen, and Pridens - have to stand up against the enemy. Listen closely, warrior.

Cunning betrayers have broken the peace treaty and now prepare a stab on our back! Their leader is Zirkon Kostrov, a knight and a loyal sheepdog of the church! He passed as many as 200 death sentences to the "heretics"!

In any other case we would have had a chance to set up for cease fire, but not with Kostrov in the lead. He's too hateful, so there is no way... as long as he's there. See what I'm driving at?.. Be aware that Kostrov is not the weakest of all - only a decent team is able to defeat him.
You know, you don’t even have to kill Kostrov. He’s a decent opponent for our soldiers, and they do have to exercise. You only have to teach him.

Is he punished enough? That's perfect, let him rest in the Purgatory for a while, it's good for him.

I officially thank you!
Kill 10 League players and return to Leo Ordin.

Right, soldier! Listen up!

By Yasker’s order the Kingdom of Elements pronounced a research site of highest priority! All samples and artifacts, acquired here, must be proceeded to ZIT Headquarders immediately!

The only problem is that the League is up and out, too. They always capture the valuable scientific staff and disrupt our plans. What’s more, they harass our military and scientific base all the time!

So here’s your mission: on behalf of the Imperial military forces, destroy ten League soldiers. Every defeated soldier, every rescued artifact draw nearer the day of our Victory!
How’s the Leage hero doing? Is he still there?

Atten! Tion!

Keep it up, soldier! This is just the way to go! Ten League leashdogs are down, and this is just a beginning! They will surely repeat their attempt tomorrow, so come back for more! At ease!
Capture all Sites of Power in Kingdom of Elements and report to Leo Ordin.

Here, in the Kingdom of Elements, are Sites of Power - just like the same sites you come across in the Holy Land. It’s where the magical energy bursts out of the ground. In the case of Holy Land, it’s Holy energy, and as to this place, we don’t know yet.

Why not? It’s the League’s fault. They want to take over, too.

Mission clear? If not, here it is: capture all Sites of Power in kingdom of Elements. Clearer now? Snap it.
Magic, shmagic... Smart and cunning combination of armed divisions that need three minutes to capture a fortification - that's what I call magic!
The senior research tutor already reported success in analyzing new objects. The hardest part of the job is done, now all we have to do is cover our scientists!
Take part in murdering Leo Ordin and report to Zirkon Kostrov in the League camp on the Medial Plateau.

Peace to you, friend. I nearly gave up hope to receive reinforcements.

Would you like to serve for the sake of the League?..

We need to wipe the Empire's nose. I mean, the Imperial commander, captain Leo Ordin. He's dug into Medial plateau with his gang, and keeps messing with us! So you have to deal with him. Gather a group of your friends, for I don't think you can defeat him alone, he's quite strong, you know.
Make sure not to kill him, though. Just teach him a lesson. Or a new one might be even worse, you know.
I’ve heard my best enemy has gone directly to Purgatory? This is good. Let him take a rest and think of it.
Kill 10 Imperial players and return to Zirkon Kostrov.

I have an important issue to discuss.

The Imperials, plague on their house, are pestering us! They always run on our campsites! Beat the guards, mess up with our provision stock, even kill someone once in a while! Our researchers are scared to make a step away from the camp without guards!

You’re our only hope. Send ten Imperials to the Purgatory, they might give us a rest then. Will you help us? Please?
Praise the Light! I hope we’ll have at least two day rest! And I know who will help us, if they ever come back. I bow to you, friend.
Capture all Sites of Power in Kingdom of Elements and report to Zirkon Kostrov.

Here, in the Kingdom of Elements, are Sites of Power - just like the same sites you come across in the Holy Land. It’s where the magical energy bursts out of the ground. In the case of Holy Land, it’s Holy energy, and as to this place, we don’t know yet.

Why not? It’s the Empire’s fault. They want to take over, too. Mission clear? If not, here it is: capture all Sites of Power in kingdom of Elements. Clearer now? Snap it.
These are not simple altars... I wonder what they do...
I have heard about your deeds. Our scientists sleep and eat near the altars! I would like to express gratitude on behalf of all my colleagues and friends!
Use the Hopping Backpack to steal eggs from Harpies' nests near the Tautlan Cliff and bring them to Laureen de Blizare in the expedition camp.

What does any inventor crave? To find proper use for their inventions. And I am no exception. I also want my creations to serve the cause of peace and science. But fate often plays cruel jokes on us and makes us cruel, too...

Sorry for being sentimental. I've just made a very tough choice. You see, stupid harpies assumed that we threat their peaceful existence. And what did they do? They attacked our scientists in the night! Some of them won't even resurrect. What a silly way to die.

It's about time we got rid of our neighbors. Take my Hopping Backpack and use it to reach their nests. Find their eggs and bring them to me. I want them to rush over here, crazed with fear and anger, where we will meet them, fully armed!
What will I do with the eggs? Throw them into the Astral, probably. Or maybe send them to the Imperial Zoo.
Great. Let's put them in plain sight and wait. Brang and his guys are eager to get down to the business. Thank you very much for helping us!
Steal 10 handfuls of Fiery Pollen in the June complex of temples on the Tautlan Cliff. Bring them to Eadweard Goodwin in the expedition camp.

As far as I know, the Tautlan Cliff is freezing cold. Nevertheless, Wormfaces live there and feel perfectly comfortable. Have you ever seen a Wormface in a fur coat? That's right, because they never wear them, which means they have some way to keep themselves warm. I know, I know, it's magic!

I don't think they deal with it each on their own. There must be some sorcery that heats their shelter in the June temple. Alchemy, probably! And I want it! Can you imagine how much profit it will bring? And the trees will be safer, too. They will cut down whole Lightwood soon, mark my words!

So, if you ever come to enter their temple, take a good look around. Maybe you will find what it is.

On the other hand, if someone misuses this alchemy, they might burn themselves, their house, and maybe even their village... We need to secure ourselves from any unnecessary losses. Let us call it "warranty case".
Is it pollen? Oh, it's hot! But that's good. I can include gloves in the pack - or a special spatula - and jack up the price even higher. But this is none of your concern. Here's your share.
Defeat Firocious at Medial Plateau and report to Brang the Merciless.

We heard, a new allod was discovered recently. You think it's cool? Well, it's freaking not! The more allods there are, the more duty staff they need. We breed fast, bot not that fast, huh. We don't even have any spare time. What if we want to hunt?

There's that giant dumb lizard prowling at Medial Plateau. It's called Firocious. One won't take it down single-handedly, and if I take my bros with me, we can easily handle it. But we just don't have time!

Maybe you can deal with it? I just can't watch it roam around unfettered anymore!
Is the lizard still alive? That has to be fixed. Go, do it!
I can see that was a hell of a fight. C'mon, tell me, how many horns have you got?
Defeat the Giant Sturgeon on the Tautlan Cliff and bring its meat to Brang the Merciless.

Argh! What do you want?! You better keep away from me when I'm that hungry... From all of us. I could eat an Elemental, or one of those Roughice folks, huh! Even though they're just skin and bones...

The thing is - we were going to go fishing. There's a huge fish on that cliff on the new allod, a giant sturgeon! It has teeth each of the size of my fist! One could make a shield out of its comb. That's one mighty beast, I'm telling you.

And we are going to eat it!

But there's no way we can leave the duty, damn it. Can you help us? Of course, that thing can't be caught with a rod - here, take my grandfather's harpoon! I'll kill you if you lose it.

Throw it right, and it will almost kill the fish. You will just have to finish it off, and bring its meat here. But you stand no chance against it without the harpoon, trust me on that, huh.

Whoa! Just look at that!

Jeez, you are the best! Thank you so much. If there's anything we can do for you, just let us know!
Use the Hopping Backpack to inspect the wrecked ships near the Tautlan Cliff and report to Laureen de Blizare in the expedition camp.

Of course, we are not the first ones to discover this allod. Long ago the Junes lived here, as you can see by the temples on Tautlan. But what's the most interesting, somebody has already come here on Astral ships. At least on two of them.

You will see them on the Northern shore of the cliff. Time and snow have been harsh on the wrecks - they have frozen deep into the ground, overgrown with ice. Approaching them won't be easy. Take this Hopping Backpack, it will help you.

I want to know when these ships were built. What has happened to them and to the crew? It must have been something terrible, but we shouldn't give up on hope. Inspect both ships and tell me if you will find something.
Remember: the ships are most probably swarming with local critters. And your intrusion won't make them happy.

Elven twin ships! They used to have an ancient tradition of buildings ships like these, though now it is forgotten. The ships are swarming with Elementals - they seem to be enjoying their new habitat. One of the ships was wrecked by some monstrous power, but the second one is untouched. And no signs of the crew on both ships.

Clearly it wasn't an Astral battle, but I am really bothered by the ships' flight trajectory as they entered the allod. Something is wrong about it...

Anyway, thank you for your help. Maybe someday we will unravel this riddle.
Activate 8 Deft Golems in the June ruins on the Tautlan Cliff. Return to the Roughice family.

Everyone keeps talking about our new trouble - the Wormfaces. They live on the cliff and won't let us explore it. Orcs thought they could just drive them away, but their fists are nothing against magic!

So we thought, why do we even have to fight if our forces are uneven? We just need to make things rough for them, and that's it! You are an experienced guerilla, so you will help us.

There are ancient June ruins on the Tautlan Cliff, and I'm sure, there are plenty of golems left among them. We just need to activate them and set them against the Wormfaces. Will you do that?
The Wormfaces should have long thrown these wrecks out into the Astral. Now they only have themselves to blame, because now Gibberlings have their hands on them!
Excellent! While the Wormfaces are dealing with the uprising of the machines, we will have time to prepare something else for them. Though we don't know what it will be yet...
Kill 15 Wormface Psionicists on the Tautlan Cliff. Return to the Yaver Fayda in the expedition camp.

Nezeb knows, I can't put up with this anymore! The Wormfaces have gone too far. They attacked our relay point the other day and stole priceless relics and ore samples!

They've been befuddling members of the expedition and conducting demonstrative executions, and now they are also standing in the way of scientific progress! This is just unpardonable. We have to teach them a lesson. A bloody lesson!

Go to the Tautlan Cliff, where they dwell. Show them what happens to those who dare to get on scientists' nerves!
Who do they think they are?! They think they can kill a defenseless researcher and get away with that? No way!
Yes, I can see their filthy blood on you. It means my colleagues are avenged! Thank you!
Defeat Primarch at the Tautlan Cliff and report to Brang the Merciless.

Ah, speak of the devil! I have a request for you, a pretty important one.

You see that hot lady? Her name is Laureen... She discovered a new allod recently. Smart as hell! And proud, like all those... you know... winged ones. Well, why wouldn't she be! One can rarely see such a hottie flying on some magical device and making discoveries.

There's pure mess going on on that allod she has discovered though. There are more Wormfaces there than goblins on the Wild Islands. One especially nasty critter, called Primarch, rules over them.

Listen, why won't you do me a favor, eh? Can you go to that allod and kill the bastard? And I will tell Laureen I killed it! I want to hit on her too badly, huh.
The bastard is still alive? Why is that?

Is he dead? Perfect! I've just told Laureen everything. Cheered her up a bit. She even gave me one of their Elven buns. I don't know why the hell they eat that stuff, but I had to take it. It was kinda a romantic gesture, huh.

It was romantic, right?
Use Heater to find 10 pieces of Crystal Quartz in the abandoned mountainfolk settlement on the Tautlan Cliff. Bring them to Eadweard Goodwin in the expedition camp.

Our brilliant Laureen has discovered a new allod! Do you know what it means? It means that I have discovered new ways to make money! Of course, you, as my best assistant, will get a good share.

Look, there was a small tribe of mountainfolk that were driven away from their settlement by spiders. I bet they must have left something valuable behind!

I know they are extremely good at extracting Crystal Quartz, which is highly priced among city jewelers. It has been long since the spiders attacked, so the precious crystals are probably buried beneath snow and ice. I will give you this magical artifact, called the Heater - it will melt everything around. The crystals shine so bright that you won't miss them!

And watch out for the spiders! Only Light knows how many of them are dwelling there...
And I thought there was nothing to do in this kingdom!
Just look at it. Mother nature always produces the best stuff!
Go to the June treasury on the Tautlan Cliff and copy the sacred writings on the central monolith. Bring the text to Yaver Fayda in the expedition camp.

Tautlan Cliff... This is how the allod that we've discovered recently is called. It can be roughly translated as "Holy Land", which most probably means... Oh, I see you're not really interested.

We've learnt the name of the cliff from the writings on one of the obelisks in the temple complex. These obelisks can be found all over the allod, and surely we would love to study all of them. Unfortunately, local fauna and the Wormfaces make our mission almost impossible... For us, but not for you.

I would be very grateful if you could stop by the treasury on the Western shore of the cliff. There is that obelisk which I am especially interested in. I need a copy of the writings on it. But be careful, the Wormfaces are literally everywhere, and as I've heard, they've even activated some of the ancient traps.
Of course, mineralogy is my primary field of expertise, but I am a scientist, after all! Who will take care of these texts if not me?
Oh my! I really hope these twirls mean something. I don't want to give another piece to the art historians!
Obtain picks from Kobolds at Hollow Ridge and use them to break bodies of 10 Boomers, then report to Yaver Fayda.

Do you really want to serve the science? Really? This is so rare in our days, I cannot believe it!
Have you ever been at the Hollow Ridge? Did you see the stone elementals there? They’re incredibly strong, these boomers. I believe their bodies might contain something, that gives them this power, this strength... it must be meteorite fragments, of course, it’s so pure and simple!
The boomers are tough and hard to break, but I once saw kobolds attack one with their picks. Believe it or not, it turned into dust within seconds! So did their picks, but it’s nothing.
Do you still feel like helping me? Obtain kobolds’ picks and use it to grind boomers to dust. Then loot their core and bring it to me. I wonder if it really is a meteorite fragment.
Have you got the Boomer’s Meteorite heart yet? I can’t wait!
What do you mean "no meteorite heart inside"? Just keep searching!
Wake up Rockie, obtain his heart and return to Yaver Fayda.

Our scouts spotted a real titan at the northern edge of the Hollow Ridge. A common elemental is relatively small in size, but this one is really huge. I’m so eager to lay my hands on his heart! It must be really precious material. Invaluable for the science!
The scouts say that there’s an ancient obelisk that will summon Rockie. It should be really so, but I’m a way too careful to check myself. Bring me the heart, be a darling.
Next time we should send Pridens on a scouting mission! At least they are not prone to dramatic exaggerations. Have you defeated Rockie, by the way?
Thank you so much! I hope he wasn’t the only Rockie here, I will certainly need more!
Unspell 5 sorcerers on the Tautlan Cliff using the enchanted wand. Return to the Roughice family.

You won't believe what we've just heard! Several sorcerers from our expedition went to the new allod that Laureen has discovered. It's called the Tautlan Cliff. At first it went well. They were studying things and made calculations...

And out of the blue, they were attacked by a bunch of Wormfaces!

No, they didn't kill anyone. The did something worse. They took possession of their minds! Now they roam around the cliff, possessed and helpless. We can't fight them, their our pals, after all. And there is no one to unspell them! But we've found a way to solve this.

Here, take this enchanted wand. Use it to turn the sorcerers into witless animals! Or into something else, if you get distracted, haha. It won't last long, but we don't need more. Even Wormface Psionicists are not good enough to control such useless imbeciles.
Don't worry, we've tested the wand on the orcs. It won't turn you into anything, as long as you hold it right.
It was fun, wasn't it? I mean... Thank you for saving us from the Wormfaces! We won't forget it. As won't the sorcerers, huh...
Use the Firework to send 15 astral pirates flying at Hollow Ridge and return to Yaver Fayda.

Pirates! I hate this scum! Real vandals! They steal everything that can be sold, and destroy everything of the slightest historical or artistic value.What we need to do is fix their brains. No pain, no violence, nothing of it! Just scare them a little.Here, this is a firecracker. Covertly attach it to a pirate and pull this cord to activate the rocket. Voila, pirate flies into the sky and learns his lesson. No blood spilt!
You don’t have to kill enemies to defeat them! Send the pirates up flying - each of them, who doesn’t fail to land safely, will instantly turn into a nice person.
Huh! The pirate firework is miraculous. I love it.
Obtain 10 pieces of tellisit from pirates at Hollow Ridge and return to Yaver Fayda.

These filthy pirates! They topped up their ships with rare minerals that were discovered and picked here, at the Hollow Ridge. They cost nothing, but have a great value for science. If I could only have these rocks back!..I would also appreciate if you kill the captain! Let him take a little rest at the Purgatory, think about it all.
If you rid us of those freaks, I swear I will name the next discovered mineral after you!
Yes, it's pure tellisit! You took care of the pirates, too, right? Thank you so much!
Set 5 waterfolks’ huts at Wet Rock and return to Brang the Merciless.

The local waterfolks totally went off the handle. Attacking our supply carts, insulting our scouts, and the other day they even told me to go and hide where the sun don't shine! Can you fancy that? I gather it's time we teach 'em a lesson.
Take this torch, set their huts on fire. If it's the force that they respect, let that be so. Five huts burnt to the ground will do the trick.
There is waterfolk trouble, huh? Nice!
Obtain 8 Murrays and 8 pieces of turtle meat at Wet Rock and return to Brang the Merciless.

Atten-tion! Rest!
Listen to my command! The camp is running out of food! The egg-headed scientists unloaded one of our food units for the sake of their stupid research devices! What should my soldiers survive on? Screws and nuts? I say, hell no!
This local, um, lerict fauna turned out to be quite nutritious. Nevermind them saying "rare species", "unique", "dying out". We've got our own skins to save! Go and shoot whatever creature you come across, drag them all here. We'll sort through them!
I’m going to heat the frying pan right now! Thank you, hero! You are always welcome here.
Steal 5 large fishes from waterfolks’ nets at Wet Rock and return to Brang the Merciless.

I miss fish. Salted fish, sundry fish, fried fish, fish and chips... It’s a pity I’m no fisherman. Waterfolks are greedy and will never agree to share or sell.
It means we’ll have to steal fish right from their nets on the lake. Go and bring at least five. And if they try and interfere into our "requisitioning", just execute them, this is the war law!
Here's fish! We love fish! You can always bring us more!
Evaporate 15 Water elementals at Wet Rock and return to Brang the Merciless.

The scientists say the local plants lack irrigation. I said, okay, no problem, my whole squad can water ‘em, we only need to put up a "Toilet" sign at the withering trees. I don’t know what drove them so mad.
Then they gave me this device. It vapors the water spirits, forms the vapor into a rain cloud and sends it off to where it’s needed. I tried it on a couple of elementals. Yeah, it’s funny, but it gets boring after a while, and I’ve got my own duties.
So, will you give me a hand? It’s nothing too complicated - first you smash the water dude, then hit this button.
So, how's the irrigation going? I don't know what those egg-headed are doing it for. It was growing somehow without them!
Good job, and it keeps you clean, right? No need to shower.
Find Elena Zimina in the frozen lands

One of our fellow travelers must be in trouble - look at that broken Hopping Backpack. The good thing is there are no blood stains around. See those tiny female footprints in the snow? The snowdrift will erase them soon, but at least we know she has gone towards the cliffs... Oh now, look how many prints of animal's paws are crossing her trail!

We must help Elena! If they eat her, Herbert will lose his mind!
Oh... how dreadful! I almost got eaten! My trouser-leg has turned to tatters, just look at it! And these were my favorite trousers...
Help Alena Mudrova understand Humk's words.

Humk was trying to say something when his kinsmen attacked the camp, but I couldn't understand a word. Where did you find him?

So this Tungar asked you to take him to the camp? Very interesting! It's a pity he does not understand us. But I've spent enough time in expeditions to be able to learn his primitive language.

We should probably start with gestures, as they are the universal mean of passing information. Don't you know that? A naked bottom showed to an opponent is taken as an offense by all known sentient beings. This is a scientifically proven fact!

Well, no, we are not going to show our bottoms to the savage. Let's try some friendly gestures - I want to see his reaction and hear the response.
These aborigines have a peculiar language... Some words seem familiar.

I think I am beginning to understand the principle of their speech. The Tungar language seems to be quite primitive and imageless.

Now, wait. I need to ask our little guest several questions.
Sneak into the Northern Tungar Camp, release Murk, and escort him to a safe place.

Humk knows where Murk is!

Tungar tribe chief, Booka-Booka, thought we were some kind of demons from their primitive religion. Ha, we have chased away the whole tribe - just the three of us - so we must have impressed them.

First Booka-Booka tried to set the "frost king", that vicious mammoth, on us. But when Tungars realized that even that monster couldn't stop us, they swarmed all over Murk and dragged him to another camp.

Murk somehow convinced Humk that he was a god and not a demon! That's why he decided to help the "gods from the skies" and tell us where Tungars have taken Murk.

I assume that Booka-Booka wants to sacrifice Murk to their ice gods. So hurry up! Be careful, Tungars are numerous, and they know these lands as the back of their hands... Or do they have paws? Whatever! Keep out of their sight!

We made it! The ancestors' spirits are guarrding us, I swear on the lights of Howlem! You were rright on time. Those dwarfs were about to cut my heart out and feed it to some snow monster they worship!

But it's too soon to rejoice. They still have Elena!
At last! I thought you abandoned me!
Obtain 15 Salt Grains from the Living Ice and return to Murk.

I saw Tungarrs taking Elena to that large cave. There must be their altar. I think they want to sacrrifice her!

It's too late to call for help! I suggest we use scare tactics, aysh! While they were carrying me to the camp, I noticed that they were terrified of the local yaks. Booka-Booka has become their chief because he managed to saddle one!

If we ride a yak into the cave, those little hunhurrs will scatter like rats!

Get some bait. Yaks love salt, rright? Booka-Booka has been feeding his yak with salty shards from Icy Elementals that roam around everywhere. Go get them, and I will think of some kind of harness.

Hurry up! We're short on time!
Have you got the bait for the yak?
Nice. We have the bait, we have the harness... But this is not enough. We need something to make the savages fill their pants. Do you think Tungars fear fire?
Get 10 Glands of Fire-breathing Lizards and bring them to Murk.

Savages have never seen explosions - there is nothing explosive in the frozen lands. A loud kaboom will scare the hell out them, ay-hya!

I saw fire-spitting lizards in the frozen lands. Tungars use their fresh innards to light torches. Do you see where I am going here?

Get 10 fire glands of those lizards, while I will think of some shell for the bombs. We will start the fireworks, hurray!
Try not to damage their fire glands! And don't let them go out!
Grreat! Now we are ready. Listen to my plan...
Bait a yak, ride it into the ice cave, kill the Tungars and their shamans, and save Elena Zimina.

Now you just need to bait a yak and mount it. You have the salt to bait it, and I've made the harness and the firecrackers. Now listen closely.

As soon as the yak comes to the bait, jump on it and shout. It will frreak out and bolt. But don't panic, eysh! Grrab its ears and direct it to the cave. Don't forget about the firecrrackers.

Remember, we need to save Elena. I will cover your back. Good luck! May the ancestors help you!
I thought I was dead! Tungars...! Watch out, the Tungars are returning!
Find the Tungars' "god" and defeat it.

Do you hear that horn? The Tungars are calling to their god! I don't know what kind of monster it is, but they wanted to feed me to it...

I'm scared! Do something! I don't want it to eat me!
What a monster... I've never seen anything like it! This creature... Is it gone? I hope it doesn't come back soon!
Examine mechanoid wreckages and report to Zimina.

Ouch, my leg! It's either broken or twisted... What a shame. There are so many interesting things here!

Look at those wreckages... Those must be Mechanoids! What were they doing here? Could it be that found traces of the Tep's presence?

Please, take a good look around - any details will make use. I think we are closer to the answer than we have ever been.
Waves of ice-cold air come from the wall.
The passage is blocked with a thick wall of ice. Probably even Eclipse's cannons wouldn't break a hole in it!
Return to Herbert and tell him about the cave.

The thick wall of ice seems indestructible, but a vague silhouette can be seen inside of it, a silhouette that resembles... a Tep's siege Mechanoid! Someone must have created this wall deliberately to block the way... To where? The passage seems to go up, so the purpose of the excavation must be hidden inside of the mountain! But how do we get inside...

Tungars? Shamans blowing horns? A worm that eats mechanoids and fights demons? What demons are you talking about and, for Astral's sake, what is that Ice Wall?

Calm down and tell me everything.
Meet Maas-Tyna at the camp and participate in battle with Tungars.

Maas-Tyna, one of our best scouts, has discovered another savage camp. It's three times bigger than ours! And the savages seem to be eager to get rid of us. Their righteous anger can be understood since we were the first to spill blood, although reluctantly... But I will not let our expedition fail!

Their last raid cost us several boxes of equipment and loads of Mirra! That is why I have ordered to attack the savage camp before they come back again. I will be thankful if you agree to lead the raid!
Aho, frriend! I've heard a lot about you. The spirrits must love you! The big battle that is waiting for us can only be won by joint efforts. You will need a whole raid to defeat the currsed Tungars!
Show shaman's tablet to Sarang Ashturi at the camp.

The tablet is covered with some weird squiggles - I don't know whether those are letters or drawings, or maybe both. I can't understand a thing...

Although... Sarang Ashturi once told me she can decipher any writings, even the most primitive ones. Maybe you should talk to her.

What is it? A sample of primitive savage writings? Interesting... Let me see!

...

Tungar vocabulary is extremely primitive. Poor linguistic system, no creative thinking at all; they take the reality for granted with no critical observation. Just looking at these simple squiggles makes my IQ drop. However, I can easily understand what is written here.

It reads that there are two worlds - the earthly one, cold and hostile, and the "heavenly" one, where the "gods" live. Tungars think that they used to live in the "heavenly" world, or maybe they just believe it's there. It is always warm and there is plenty of tasty raw meat for everyone. Yes, raw meat. They seem to love it. I wonder how come they haven't eaten each other yet.

The most interesting thing is that they believe the cave is some kind of a "threshold" of the heavenly world. It is written that a ritual sacrifice of a "demon" will split the ice and open up the way to heaven. Maybe we should have let them sacrifice Elena? I'm only kidding, I'm kidding!

Well, we need to break through that Ice Wall and take a look at the "heavenly" world where the Tungar "gods" live. But how do we do that, that's the question.
Gather lost signal beacons and find Murk.

Just before landing this masterpiece of goblin skillfulness overheated and went totally dead. Luckily, a furry animal saved me from falling on hard ice... Though it turned out to be a huge hungry lynx.

Imagine how staggered it was! Huh, it's not everyday tasty and nutritious researchers fall from the sky. So as soon as I realized I was about to become a dinner for a dozen cats, I rushed to the nearest cliff. You see... My trousers are all ragged.

But this is not the worst. While I was running, I lost my bag with beacons. The lynxes tore it and stole all the beacons. The rest of the Surveyors will not be able to land without them.

We need to find what was lost. And Murk is nowhere to be seen... I'm not worried about the big guy, it's just he has most of our supplies in his backpack. And my spare trousers!

Aho, frriends! You are right on time. I guess these funny savages were about to flay and fry me. Or fry and flay, I didn't really get it. Such funny folks! They went at me as soon as they saw me, muttering something in their language: "Tungar, tungar..." I fought back, of course.

Well, I know they are relict species and have to be preserved, but I ain't letting any savages eat me, eysh!
Install the signal beacons on the coast and wait for the rest of the Surveyors to arrive.

Do you have the beacons, zoor? That's good. We will deal with Elena's torn trousers later, when we are warm and fed. The trainers always say, no Golas is a good thinker when hungry!

I am afraid the light of the beacons will not only show the way to our boats, but also attract unwanted attention. Ay-hya! Those Tungar runts are not the biggest danger of these frozen lands. I swear on the ancestors, I saw an ice hunhurr!
Hurry up! My fur turns to icicles! It's cold as in Golases' forgotten dreams!
Oh! I didn't expect it to be so cold. It makes me wonder if our quartermaster has stocked up with enough warm clothes!

I have two news - a bad one and a very bad one. Here is the very bad one: the Darkblood Citadel cannot stay in the storm raging around Ferris, and soon Amadeus will drive it back to Avilon. The bad news is, we have received a weak signal from the June Portal! You may ask, what is bad about it? Well, the bad thing is - I am not sure we can reach it. Not to mention that launching it may turn out to be almost impossible. But we don't have a choice, do we?

Well, the three of you have some teamwork experience, so now we entrust you with the scouting mission. The damned Portal must be somewhere behind those extremely sharp ice cliffs. Yes, right where you ran into the local savages. There must be their camp, or even a town...

Try to stay out of trouble this time!

I asked you to stay out of trouble! Why, why would you confront these poor... what was their name, Tungars? These poor Tungars!

Oh, this is going nowhere good.

Anyway, now we have a comfortable camp, though stinking with the savages, and an intact Portal. Now let's get to our main visit purpose!
Ferris is an inexhaustible source of mysteries. Who are these Tungars, for instance? Degraded goblins or evolved walruses? Nobody knows...
Obtain 10 pieces of meat and 10 mammoth skins at the Barren Ridge and return to the Shaggy family at the camp.

Heya! You want new felt boots, too? Alas! I've run out of them. Felt boots and furry coats - all gone in the blink of an eye! And still most Surveyors didn't get any of those. And we will be running short on food supplies pretty soon, too...

We've found several very warm furry capes left that the savages had left behind. They are too small to be worn by humans, but if we find some more of that fur and some fresh meat as well, that'd be great. Will you help us? Or Herbert will skin us alive instead!
If we wanted to feed all that horde, we should have taken two galleons of food, not these two boxes!
These are nice, warm skins, almost like our fur. They will make good clothes! But the meat is worthless - it's tough and distasteful... Anyway, we are not in a position to complain. Thank you!
Kill 15 Tungars hiding in the snow near the camp.

Those Tungars don't fear us at all. What a savagery! They keep prowling around the camp, they may even stab someone eventually. The Surveyors are afraid to leave the camp even to answer the call of nature!

You are going on a scouting mission, aren't you? If you notice any Tungars, kill them on the spot!

I'm afraid those pigmies will give us some bad times...
I know Waterfolk, I know Forestfolk, I know Mountainfolk... But I've never heard of Tungars!
They say, the best fight is the one that never happened. And so say I! If you finish off all the enemies before the fight starts, there will be no fight!
Find the Shouter in the Icy Spikes, defeat him, and report to Choof the Forester.

Hey there! What are you doing here? I thought Herbert has sent you on some kind of a research, no?

Well... Since you're here anyway, can you help your fellas out, eh?

Our Wiseguy-in-Chief complains about some beast that screams wildly in the outskirts and distracts his feeblings from work. He told me to shut the thing up, huh! But you know, we played Spades with the furry guys the other day, and I gambled away my hatchet... I can tear any beast with my bear hands, that's a sure thing! It's just, this one seems to be huge as a Yasker's statue...

Alright, I chickened out. Will you kill that screamer for me? I will owe you one. Deal? But don't go on your own - the thing sounds just like our sergeant back in the military school, and that bastard could beat cold five of us, huh!
I should make the furry lads drunk and win my hatchet back. But this time we'll play Crazy Eights!
Wow, it's quiet! It has shut up, finally. Forever silent now, huh. I owe you one, you got my word on that.
Use the Magimeter to measure the magic field of a live lynx, the bones of an unknown predator, the ice block, and the magic anomaly.

It's time to get down to the research. First, we need to study local magical flows. If Tep had used his sorcery here, it must have left some traces in the magic field.

I'm afraid the Magimeter that I have brought with me is busted, and I have no time to calibrate it. Will you help me?

You need to measure magical fields of several objects - a living one, an inanimate one, and a dead one that used to be alive, and see if there are any anomalous disturbances. Will you do that? When you finish, find Murk - I sent him to the icy lake. I think it might have an unnatural origin, and if there are any anomalies, the Magimeter will surely detect it.
It's better to be covered with fur than with pimples like our Elven chief, haha!
Aho, frriend! Herbert has sent me to explore the area, and I have found something very interesting.
Kill 15 Snow Lynxes and return to Peter Lukin at the camp.

There are way too many lynxes here. The cats must be thinking they are the kings of these snowy plains. Well, we need to show them that they are not, before they tear any of our scientist tadpoles apart.

Will you handle this? Your job is simple - to reduce the lynxes' population by 15 or so heads. Come back when you're done.
You can't even get a decent piece of meat from these cats. Absolutely useless creatures.
Well, that's something. At least you will blow off the steam and warm up a bit! And we will surely find a use for the skins.
Measure the tension of magic flows near the ice knobs on the surface of the lake.

This is a weird place. I can sense the prresence of the spirits, but they don't want to talk to me. Old blood, empty mind... and sorcery! Those ice knobs make my fur stand up. Do you feel that, too, zoor?

Herbert wanted mysteries? Well, that's one heck of a mystery. I swear on the grave of my ancestors, something wicked happened here. The blood was flowing... But we need to be sure.

Have you calibrated your magical compass, or whatever that Elven device is called? Magometerr? Magi-...? Magimeter, alright. Trry to measure those ice knobs. I'm sure Herbert will be surprised with the results, eysh!

Be careful, the ice is thin.
What are you doing here? I thought I sent you to calibrate the Magimeter!

Hey, wake up! Do you hear me? Light be thanked! We thought your Spark got lost on the way to the Purgatory.

Are you wondering what has happened? So do I. Wait, let me tell you what I saw.
Talk to Herbert about the mystery of the lake.

You know, you are lucky. When Murk dragged you from beneath the ice and we carried you to the camp, you looked as live as a frozen rock. We thought you could be easier to finish you and wait till you resurrect, but I am against violence, and the sight of blood makes me depressed. So we tried to defrost you, and we succeeded, as you see. At least you don't look like a stiff body anymore.

Now tell us everything. I am wondering what kind of force could have lured you to the ice-cold water? And where is my damned Magimeter?
Don't thank me. Mutual aid and supportiveness are the basic principles of our life!
I'm going to search for Elena and bring her back at any cost. Are you with me, zoor?
Aho! You owe me one, frriend! I sweated my back off when I was carrying you across the ice, while fighting off Tungars and lynxes!
Set out to search for missing Elena together with Murk.

The ancestors have told us to never leave our kinsmen out in the cold. Even though Elena is of a different race, she is still frrom our pack. If she is alive, we will save her. But if the Realm has taken her tya, we will take the lives of her killers by the rright of blood!

Follow me!
Come on! Have you found Elena?

What?! Murk is also gone?!

That's enough! No Surveyor is allowed to leave the camp before we are completely safe!
Complete Surveyors' quests to reinforce the defense of the camp.

I'm doing this in spite of myself. Please understand: I have to stop the research! Elena is missing. Murk is most likely dead. And before that, we almost lost you!

Before the camp is safe, before these savages stop lurking around, I forbid any research activity. Science may demand sacrifice... But I don't want any of my Surveyors to sacrifice their lives.
Dangers do not scare me, but I don't usually take risks thoughtlessly. There is nothing more precious than life!

Peter has reported on at least twenty Tungars who died in the ingenious traps. Tur was over the moon when he saw the plumes of smoke above the Tungar camp. And the bunch of crack-headed Gibberlings tried their own slop and then beat Choof up! Three times! Each one! What an atrocity!

It's not that I don't approve of such methods... Well, as I already said, science demands sacrifice. So may it be someone else's sacrifice!
Obtain 10 solid bones and 20 sharp saber-tooth fangs at the Barren Ridge and return to Peter Lukin at the camp.

Hey there.

I heard you were on fighting terms with the Tungars. Honestly, I don't approve of that. But I do understand.

Each soldier of the Empire believes in the friendship of the peoples! But what do we do with the peoples that don't want to be friends with us? I used to be in the frontier troops. And I saw a lot of those who misinterpreted the notion of friendship. In order to hedge ourselves from their friendliness, we set a lot of traps on the border, so that very few of them made it to the middle of the exclusion zone...

Where was I? If you bring me plenty of solid and sharp stuff, I will make you some traps that will break off the feet of those curious bastards!

Huh... Bones and fangs. I expected something more... metallic. Well, what the heck, sand paper will work if you've got nothing to wipe with... I will make the traps out of these!

Bring some more of these bones and fangs. The more traps we set, the less sword brandishing we have to do. Laziness is the engine for progress!
Track the beast that has left the giant footprints and return to Peter Lukin at the camp.

Wow, what a paw! This footprint looks like one of the local saber-toothed cats, but it's four times bigger.

What if that monster reaches the camp? At night, when everyone is asleep? There will be a lot of killing!

I suggest you track the beast down and finish it before it decides to feast on the Surveyors. You will both do a good thing and improve your reputation as a hunter.

But you better not do this on your own. Take your friends with you and slay the monster!
Ahem... Local animals don't fear us at all. Hunting is as easy as pie!

What are you saying? A hill-sized saber-tooth? With arm-long fangs? Sorry, I won't believe that until I see one. Do you have any proof?

...

Wow! An armored grunt could fit in that cat's jaw! You must be one hell of a fighter. You have my respect!
Obtain 10 solid bones and 20 sharp saber-tooth fangs at the Barren Ridge and return to Peter Lukin at the camp.

Hey there.

I heard you were on fighting terms with the Tungars. Honestly, I don't approve of that. But I do understand.

Each soldier of the Empire believes in the friendship of the peoples! But what do we do with the peoples that don't want to friends with us? I used to be in the frontier troops. And I saw a lot of those who misinterpreted the notion of friendship. In order to hedge ourselves from their friendliness, we set a lot of traps on the border, so that very few of them made it to the middle of the exclusion zone...

Where was I? Right, if you bring me plenty of solid and sharp stuff, I will make you some traps that will break off the feet of those curious bastards!

Huh... Bones and fangs. I expected something more... metallic. Well, what the heck, sand paper will work if you've got nothing to wipe with... I will make the traps out of these!

Bring some more of these bones and fangs. The more traps we set, the less sword brandishing we have to do. Laziness is the engine for progress!
Obtain 10 roots of Creeping Iceblooms and 15 petals of Frostleafs.

Hey, we've been looking for you!

Herbert told our family to stay within the camp no matter what. He says, local elephants can take us for some furry rats and trample us. We got back at him with a bucket of water spilled by the door of his tent... He slid all the way to the gates, haha! But still, we can't disobey. It's a shame though...

The thing is, we have noticed a couple of very curious herbs around here... They are growing right on the snow! And make a great infusion, by the way. Unfortunately, we have run out of them...

You are allowed to leave the camp, right? Could you do us a favor and bring us some Frostleaf tops and roots of Creeping Icebloom? We will repay with our fine infusion, brewed with a secret recipe!
Oh, bugger. No more beer, no wine, no rum, even all brew is gone - thanks to Choof... How are we supposed to warm ourselves up?

Our brew will be ready any minute now. Then we will add these herbs and make the drink of the gods! Once Tur tried it and then crushed an ice rock into pieces with his horns! The one we were hiding behind, huh.

We're not some kind of drunkards! A jar of fine booze is what we need to survive in this frozen hell.

You want some more? It's all gone now, I'm afraid. If you get us some more roots and herbs, we'll brew it in no time!
Collect 5 device parts and bring them to Herbert de Vevre at the camp.

Parts in the chest look very old and battered. It seems like they have been rusting here for decades, and the thick rust have transformed them completely. Their markings resemble the Imperial ones, but you cannot be sure about it.

Probably Herbert knows what that is and what it is doing among the snowy plains.
Sorry, I'm busy. I need to re-correlate the Magimeter data that you have obtained with the local magic flows rose.
Why would you bring me this rubbish? The Shaggy family must have given it to you! I told them to bring along only new and high-quality equipment. Preferably made by Elves!
Obtain 5 bile samples of shaggy yaks at the Barren Ridge and bring them to Herbert de Vevre at the camp.

Interesting... You say that these pieces of junk have been rusting on Ferris for many years. You think you might have found the signs of Tep's presence? Oh, I wish I could believe that. As a real scientist, first I need to see the evidence.

The markings on these parts could confirm or refute your theory. If only we could rub off the rust and make them out! I'm ashamed to say, but we don't have any caustic chemical agents, and there is no other mean to get rid of the rust without damaging the marking. Though we can try using some caustic organic bile...
Have you found something caustic enough? I'm a researcher, after all, not a cutthroat pack leader!

What a stench... It burns, too!

Let's have a look...

The marking is strange. I've never seen it before. It is obviously Imperial, and I can't make out the manufacture date, but it's at least 50 years ago.

I can read something... "To be used at the Gates object". Hmm... I've heard about the "Gates-2" laboratory, but I've never wondered what had happened to the first "Gates". Is it here, too? On Ferris? But why are there no mentions of that neither in the archives nor in the chronic, and neither have our informers back at the ZIT Headquarters heard of it? Oops, I shouldn't have said that...

So, the bottom line is: we have one more riddle instead of an answer. Now even the visions that you had in the lake don't sound like mere hallucinations.

A weird shard at the bottom, Imperial scientists, mechanics, Tep... It all winds up into a tight ball that we will have to unreel.

Continue searching! I'm sure we are about to find out the truth!
Obtain 10 roots of Creeping Iceblooms and 15 petals of Frostleafs.

Kill 10 Tungars at the Barren Ridge, burn their camp, and return to Tur the Bull's Horn at the camp.

Tungars! I hate damned Tungars! They're thick and they stink! They're just like Choof, but smaller.

I saw them running towards the Barren Ridge. I think they have another settlement there. Let's attack them first, before they kill us all!

Go to the Barren Ridge and feed ten of them to the worms. If you find a whole camp, burn it to the ground! Make them fear us!
Well, well, how many Tungars have you finished off today?

People think that we, Minotaurs, are mean and rude. That's not true! They just tease us all the time, they call us horned dimwits, and we get angry. So we hit the mockers first! Everyone gets the language of fists.

Ho-o-oh... Be-at. No beat! Humk! Humk come. Humk boo-boo.

Mrr... Murr... Murrrk! Humk Murk! Humk come. No beat! Camp! Murk Humk camp come! No beat!
I wish I'd talked to Tungars instead of Elena. I could have come to an agreement with them.

Wow! A real Tungar! Does he bite? Can I stroke him?

Why does he stare at me so angrily? Is he sick? Or mayde contageous?
Kill 10 Tungars at the Barren Ridge, burn their camp, and return to Tur the Bull's Horn at the camp.

Fight Tungars on Ferris to obtain 25 Magic Stones. Find offerings in Tungar houses in the Silent Toroses and obtain a tusk of a fierce mammoth. Offer up the gifts on the hill by the lake and return to Herbert de Vevre at the camp.

Your story makes me wonder... Obviously Tep's servants have come here because of these sealed passages. Maybe there is some kind of a secret Imperial base inside? The most obvious guess is usually the right one, but let's not put aside other options. Anything can be behind these walls, even the Tungar "heaven" with its "gods" and "demons".

Speaking of Tungars. Sarang Ashturi has found a description of some kind of ritual in the drawings that you'd brought that can "open up the way to heaven". Maybe this is how the ice passage can be destroyed? I really doubt that Tungar rituals involve some great sorcery, but we saw what their shamans can do. Why not give it a shot?

First we will need some special stones that all Tungars have. They believe that they contain a part of their souls. This belief is involved with their sorcery. We will need a lot of those stones, so get ready for a tough fight. Then you will have to go West, to the Silent Toroses. Find the ritual offerings in one of the Tungar huts. And finally, we will need a mammoth's tusk. These beasts dwell around there, too. Be careful, they are not so easily killed.

Obtain all these things and take them to the Tungar sanctuary - the high hill by the lake. In complete silence, put the offerings on the ground and mentally appeal to the Progenitor. Yes, this is what it says - appeal to the Progenitor. The description is vary vague about the outcome of the ritual. The only thing I could understand is that you will hear "the voice of thunder".

Good luck! And be careful.
We have stocked up on provisions and found backup energy sources. Now we only have to demolish this cursed wall.

So the ritual worked? I must admit I'm surprised. So that mysterious Tungar Progenitor exists, after all. I wonder why he hasn't caused any trouble so far. Huh... I'll take a closer look at that horn.

Well, we are as prepared as we can possibly be under the circumstances. It's time to break the Ice Wall!
Repel Tungars' attack on the camp

Tungars are preparing to attack! I knew these nasty dwarfs would be back again! Arrgh, I will give some hell to the bastards!

There are three passages leading to the camp, and the Tungars will attack on all sides, that's a sure thing. I will help you, though this isn't going to be easy.

Use whatever it takes - traps, Gibberling slop - but don't let them inside of the camp. Otherwise we're all dead!

Phew! We barely made it. The savages almost broke onto the camp. They could have damaged the equipment, or even kill someone.

But I'm afraid they will come again. They failed today, they can try again tomorrow. So you better stay close to the camp.
